_note: The reference film's real manifest. `node scripts/assemble.mjs` turns this plus the
eleven voiceover files into index.html, and lands on 44.189s against the shipped cut's
44.2 — the 11ms is the hand-rounding in the original, which is the point: measure once
in a script and the number stops being something you maintain.
You write: which frame, which VO file, how it leaves. You never write a duration —
assemble.mjs measures each frame from its narration with ffprobe.
`pad` is the breath after the last word, before the transition starts. 0.25s is the
default and most frames just take it. The two that don't are decisions: 03-turn is the
pivot of the whole film and 11-cta is the end card, and both are held longer on purpose.
That is what a pad is for — rhythm, not slack.
`out.type` is one of dissolve, zoom-through, push, push-right, cut. Note that this film
uses four of them and groups them by meaning: zoom-through where one thing causes the
next, push through the product sequence, dissolve between unrelated beats. A film where
every crossing is the same move reads as a slideshow.
The last frame has no `out` — nothing follows it to cross into.
